text:
Maya: quick heads-up — I started an intake for Cassini-6B (opensource fork we got from the intake bucket). want to align on quant targets + catalog metadata before we spin up perf runs
Oliver: Thanks — what's our baseline perf/quality target? latency SLO and throughput target?
Maya: target p95 < 120ms for 256-token streams on p3-like instance; throughput ~ 120 reqs/s per GPU for 8-token avg gen. quality: should be within 3% of our LLMbench Rouge/QA composite vs baseline fp16
Cheng: for quant experiments i'd start with NF4-like 4-bit then fallback to PTQ8 int8. NF4 tends to preserve quality on decoder-only. can run a quick windowed KV-cache smoke to validate correctness
Maya: agreed. can we add a small eval set: 500 prompts sampled from chat, summarization, code gen, and instruction-following?
Samira: FYI from comms: we need a model-catalog blurb (short description, recommended workloads, cost tier, known limitations) and a doc PR with upgrade notes if we promote to hosted. timeline? next-week release cadence?
Jules: capacity note — Dedicated pool is tight next week. if we plan a hosted canary, suggest 0.5% traffic for 12h, then 2% for 24h, then 10% progressive. fallback policy to Lumen-13B (or the configured latency-failover model) if p95 or error-rate exceeds thresholds
Oliver: who owns the catalog entry + tags? I'll take the perf numbers but need someone to write the catalog copy and the quickstart snippet
Samira: I'll draft the catalog blurb and announcement outline. need the: model size, typical cost multiplier, recommended quant profile, known opt-outs (no streaming for now?), and example prompts
Cheng: pointer to perf harness: repo eng-ml/perfbench. run matrix: quant=[nf4,ptq8], batch=[1,4,8], seq=[128,256,512]. example run: 
```bash
./perfbench run --model cassini-6b --quant nf4 --batch 4 --seq 256 --out /tmp/cassini-nf4-b4-s256.json
```
Maya: also add regression evals: our standard suites + a small safety checkset (named cassini_safety_v1) to catch hallucination regressions and profanity. capture outputs for human review if composite score drops > 2%
Jules: rollout gating: automated checks (p95, 99, errors, upstream queueing), quality gates (composite eval delta), and stale-kv correctness test. if any fail, auto rollback and alert #incidents + oncall
deploy-bot: deploy event — staging/cassini-6b:nf4 pushed by cheng at 1775554800
Cheng: pushed a staging image and started nf4 smoke on a single GPU. no obvious shape issues. collecting perf data now
Oliver: once you have the perf json attach to the ticket. I'll run the A/B compare script (eng-ml/tools/ab_compare.py) and generate the delta table
Maya: doc checklist for PR: 1) catalog entry (short + long) 2) quickstart snippet 3) known-limits and quant guidance 4) migration notes for Dedicated 5) announcement blurb draft for marketing
Samira: I'll take the announcement blurb. quick ask: prefer community-first release or soft enterprise-only beta? thinking enterprise-first for SLA reasons
Maya: enterprise-first makes sense given current SLAs and capacity. we can do a small community preview on a dedicated sandbox later
Jules: will schedule a canary window in the release calendar after perf numbers are in. can someone post the expected cost multiplier for nf4 vs fp16?
Cheng: preliminary: nf4 ~0.25x cost of fp16 for tokens (memory halves + kernel efficiency), PTQ8 ~0.45x. will confirm with costbench runs
Oliver: perfect. plan: Cheng runs perf matrix today, Oliver will run A/B compare, Maya + Samira finalize docs, Jules schedules canary. callout: tag the PRs with `cassini-6b` and `model-catalog`
Maya: thanks — I'll open the intake ticket with checklist and assign tasks. dropping the eval set path: s3://redwood-evals/cassini/seed_v1.json
Samira: marking comms action: draft announcement + slack post + release notes. targeting internal review by Thu
Cheng: perf runs started. ETA for first matrix results ~ 3 hours
Oliver: noted. will be standing by to process outputs and kick off canary gating once thresholds are met
Maya: great. tagging folks: @Cheng @Oliver @Samira @Jules. updating ticket now :raised_hands:
